characters.intro: The men and women caught in the crossroads.

list.name: Fitz
list.tagline: Orphaned by empire, shaped by war. Called back from vacation to a site that should have stayed buried.

list.name: Lotte
list.tagline: She overheard what she wasn't meant to hear. Now she can't unhear it.

list.name: Liz
list.tagline: Archaeology isn't her passion. Drama most certainly is. She insisted on coming.

list.name: Milan
list.tagline: He found what was buried. Now he fears what it will unbury.
